purpose: A comprehensive insurance policy analysis dashboard that allows users to upload PDFs for deep-dive neural analysis of clauses, risks, and hidden terms, providing transparency scores, key insights, and actionable recommendations.

sections: Analysis Results Dashboard (Transparency Score + Neural Summary + Key Insights)
Metrics Grid (Policy Highlights, Waiting Periods, Exclusions, Documents)

content_sections.name: Upload Zone
content_sections.heading: AI Policy Inspector
content_sections.subheading: Upload any insurance policy PDF for a deep-dive neural analysis of clauses, risks, and hidden terms. Empower your underwriting with precision.

content_sections.name: Analysis Results
items: Transparency Score: 98% circular progress indicator with 'Not clarity on policy limits' note
Neural Summary: Comprehensive General Liability (CGL) policy analysis text
Key Insight: Cyber extortion included in base coverage with no extra deductible
Attention Required: Waiting period for business interruption is 48 hours vs 24h market standard

content_sections.name: Quick Metrics Grid
items: Policy Highlights: Full Worldwide Coverage, Prior Acts Included
Waiting Periods: Theft/Burglary 30 Days, General Loss None
Documents: KYC Compliance (checked), Underwriting Report (checked), Medical Annex (unchecked)

items.title: Ambiguous Co-payment Clause
items.description: The terminology used on Page 14 regarding co-pay splits for outpatient surgical procedures is statistically likely to cause claim friction.
items.recommendation: Append a rider to explicitly define percentage mass cost sharing.

items.title: Non-Standard Notice Period
items.description: The 15-day cancellation notice period falls below the mandated state minimum of 30 days for this commercial category.
items.recommendation: Update clause 8.2 to reflect 30-day statutory minimums.

items.title: Insufficient Subrogation Right
items.description: Current wording limits the insurer's ability to recover losses from third-party contractors due to waiver broadness.
items.recommendation: Insert third-wave language to preserve primary recovery rights.

notes: This is Step 5 of 6 in a multi-step workflow (Deep Dive). The page shows results after a PDF has been analyzed. The design uses a clean, professional SaaS aesthetic with blue as the primary accent color. Cards use white backgrounds with subtle borders and rounded corners (approximately 8-12px radius). The overall spacing is generous with consistent padding around sections.
